in_marathi.name: Adhishree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhishree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adhishree is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Goddess of Prosperity'. This name is rich in cultural and historical significance. It is believed that the goddess Adishree, also known as Mahalaxmi, bestows wealth, success, and prosperity upon her devotees. This name is a powerful reminder of the divine feminine and the abundance she brings into our lives.
